audit_trail.status_change_reason: The former evaluator required a non-empty download_date and generic license_or_terms field, so it could not represent official PH2-specific research/educational terms separately from Kaggle license metadata. The revised gate validates the exact authoritative terms, verified source-identity evidence, Kaggle metadata, citation, and narrow non-commercial/no-redistribution intended use. It does not treat Kaggle Other as a license.

The data included in the PH² database can be used for research and educational purposes.
It is important to note that redistribution and commercial use is not allowed.
All publications that make use of this dataset must cite the following paper:
The PH² database and PH² Browser are only available for research and educational purposes.

evidence: Original PH2_dataset.txt and PH2_dataset.xlsx each contain 200 unique IDs and agree on clinical diagnoses and 80/80/40 counts.
The manifest matches the original clinical metadata and the local set contains 200 unique derived images.
The preserved package structure contains 200 dermoscopic images, 200 lesion masks and 50 ROI masks; all BMPs passed the local integrity audit.
Kaggle listing metadata matches the recorded ref, dataset ID, uploader and version.
Local integrity details and hashes are recorded in verification_report.json.
limitations: No acquisition date or original Kaggle archive is retained; exact byte-level linkage to Kaggle version 2 is not independently verified.
Source-identity verification does not assert that Kaggle grants a license.
